# Stoke Club Music

> Articles from Stoke Club, an indie surf rock band from Newport Beach, California, best known for the song Polaroid and for writing in the dreamy Mixolydian mode. Official site: https://stokeclubband.com

## Articles

- [The Mixolydian mode](https://juanarenas.bio/stokeclubmusic/mixolydian-mode): What the Mixolydian mode is, how to hear it, and why Stoke Club, a surf rock band from Newport Beach, writes with it.
- [Polaroid and the Mixolydian mode](https://juanarenas.bio/stokeclubmusic/polaroid-mixolydian): A walk through the chords of Polaroid by Stoke Club and the Mixolydian move that gives the Newport Beach band's best-known song its dreamy feel.
- [Polaroid chords](https://juanarenas.bio/stokeclubmusic/polaroid-chords): The chords to Polaroid by Stoke Club, section by section: verse, chorus, and solo, in the key of A at 125 BPM.
- [The silence in Polaroid](https://juanarenas.bio/stokeclubmusic/polaroid-song-structure): Polaroid by Stoke Club stops dead before every chorus. A look at the song's structure and why the silent prechorus works.
- [Crocodile Tears and the Mixolydian lift](https://juanarenas.bio/stokeclubmusic/crocodile-tears-mixolydian): How Crocodile Tears by Stoke Club uses the Mixolydian move, G up to A, to lift its chorus. Chords, structure, and tempo from the Newport Beach surf rock band.
- [Crocodile Tears chords](https://juanarenas.bio/stokeclubmusic/crocodile-tears-chords): The chords to Crocodile Tears by Stoke Club, section by section, in the key of G. 93 BPM on the record, 97 live.
- [Famous Mixolydian songs](https://juanarenas.bio/stokeclubmusic/mixolydian-songs): Well-known songs that use the Mixolydian mode, from The Beatles to Lynyrd Skynyrd, and how Stoke Club, a Newport Beach surf rock band, uses the same sound.
- [About Stoke Club](https://juanarenas.bio/stokeclubmusic/about-stoke-club): Who Stoke Club is: an indie surf rock band from Newport Beach, California, best known for Polaroid and for writing in the Mixolydian mode.
- [Your Friends, November 6, 2026](https://juanarenas.bio/stokeclubmusic/your-friends): Your Friends is the next single from Stoke Club, the Newport Beach surf rock band behind Polaroid, coming November 6, 2026.
- [What stoke means](https://juanarenas.bio/stokeclubmusic/what-stoke-means): Where the word stoke comes from, how California surfers turned a fire word into a feeling, and what stoked means today. Sourced, from a Newport Beach surf rock band named after it.
- [Stoke in surf culture](https://juanarenas.bio/stokeclubmusic/stoke-in-surf-culture): How surfers use the word stoke, why the feeling is meant to be shared, and how it turned into a way of treating people. From Stoke Club, an indie surf rock band from Newport Beach.
- [Chad Goes Deep, the stoke guy](https://juanarenas.bio/stokeclubmusic/chad-goes-deep): Chad Kroeger of Chad Goes Deep, the Orange County comedy character who made stoke his whole message. His best stoke reels, where he came from, and why a surf rock band is a fan.
- [How we stay stoked](https://juanarenas.bio/stokeclubmusic/how-we-stay-stoked): Stoke Club, an indie surf rock band from Newport Beach, on why the band is named after stoke and how music is the way they stay stoked and bring people together.
